description: Managed here: GitHub Actions, the pinned ruff version in validate.yml, and the test harness.

Deliberately not managed: caldav, icalendar and vobject. Home Assistant installs them into the same environment as the built-in caldav integration, so they must match the versions core pins, not the latest release on PyPI. They live in manifest.json (which no manager reads) and are mirrored in requirements_test.txt, where the rule below pins them.

packageRules.description: Mirrors the manifest.json pins, which follow Home Assistant core.
